rd.heading: Research and Development Expenses
rd.text: Research and development expenses decreased by $11.2 million and $10.3 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, compared to prior periods. The decrease of $11.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was primarily related to a decrease of acquired In-Process Research and Development (“IPR&D”) of $12.0 million related to the Serpin Licensing Agreement that took place in the third quarter of 2025 offset by an increase in HAL-CINP-203 clinical trial costs of $0.5 million, an increase in drug development and manufacturing costs of $0.2 million and an increase in salaries and related personnel costs of $0.1 million. The decrease of $10.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was primarily related to a decrease in acquired IPR&D of $12.0 million related to the Serpin Licensing Agreement offset by an increase in HAL-CINP-203 clinical trial costs of $1.1 million, an increase in drug development and manufacturing costs of $0.3 million and an increase in salaries and related personnel costs of $0.3 million.

intro.text: We are a pre-revenue, development-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing new medicines to treat pain and neuropathy. Following the closing of the Combination described below, we became the sole owner of Pharmagesic (Holdings) Inc. (“Pharmagesic”) and their wholly owned subsidiary, Wex Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (“Wex”), and Wex’s wholly owned subsidiaries, IWT Bio, Inc. (“IWT”), Wex Medical Corporation (“WMC”), and Wex Medical Limited (“WML”). Our pipeline is focused on treating chronic neuropathic pain and neuropathy. Our Halneuron® Na v 1.7 modulation program is intended to treat chronic and acute pain disorders. Our recently licensed SP16 program is centered on a cell signaling molecule that has shown early promise in treating neuropathy and nerve damage.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
